stem_book: Figure shows a composite system of two uniform rods of the same material and cross-section (same mass per unit length): a rod of length 2L along the y-axis from O and a rod of length L along the x-axis from O. Then the coordinates of the centre of mass of the system of rods are (a) (L/2, 2L/3) (b) (L/4, 2L/3) (c) (L/6, 2L/3) (d) (L/6, L/3)
work: masses 2m at (0,L), m at (L/2,0) ⇒ x = (m·L/2)/3m = L/6, y = (2m·L)/3m = 2L/3 (equal λ assumed, added to stem)
